data.description:
## What
After runner.py no longer imports classify_tier, perform atomic cleanup:

1. Delete `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/classifier.py` — no longer imported anywhere
2. Delete `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_classifier.py` — tests for deleted module
3. In `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py`: update all occurrences of `patch("dso_ci_review.runner.classify_tier", ...)` to `patch("dso_ci_review.runner.subprocess", ...)` (or equivalent subprocess.run patch), adjusting mock return values to return a completed subprocess mock with JSON stdout matching bash classifier output format

## Mock shift pattern
Before: `patch("dso_ci_review.runner.classify_tier", return_value={"selected_tier": "standard", ...})`
After: patch subprocess.run call that returns `CompletedProcess(stdout=json.dumps({"selected_tier": "standard", ...}), returncode=0)`

Occurrences in test_runner_smoke.py at approximately lines: 309, 412, 516, 718, 815 (and any others that mock classify_tier).

## Why
Completes the migration. classifier.py is dead code after Task B; test_classifier.py tests dead code. Existing mocks must be updated to keep the test suite green.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/classifier.py (delete)
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_classifier.py (delete)
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py (modify — fix 5+ mock patches)

## Acceptance Criteria
- classifier.py does not exist: `! test -f plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/classifier.py`
- test_classifier.py does not exist: `! test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_classifier.py`
- No remaining references to classify_tier in test_runner_smoke.py
- make lint passes
- make format-check passes

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — fixes tests broken by Task B's implementation

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/classifier.py (delete)
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_classifier.py (delete)
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py (modify)
data.title: UPDATE: atomic cleanup — delete classifier.py + test_classifier.py, fix classify_tier mocks in test_runner_smoke.py
